summary: Sony Group Corporation filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) announcing the introduction of a performance share unit plan and the grant of first-series PSUs to 18 recipients. The Compensation Committee resolved the plan on October 30, 2026; awards total 622,360 units corresponding to up to 1,244,720 shares at maximum 200% payout. Vesting runs over a three-fiscal-year performance period tied to Total Shareholder Return and other metrics. This is routine equity compensation, not a special situation; watch dilution and TSR targets.
